purpose: Define the bidirectional flow grammar of the D1-D11 Axis so the Atlas can place residue, obligations, recurrence, repair, growth, transmission and integration consistently without confusing project symbolism with empirical physics.
boundary: D1-D11 polarity is project-symbolic and analytical. Lower/upper, hell/heaven, magnetism, light and karmic flow are not physical altitude, measurable spiritual force or scientific electromagnetism. Empirical money, energy, goods, people, data and legal obligations keep their own units, sources and direction and must never be numerically merged with symbolic/karmic quantities.

master_law.axis_mundi: One vertical connective structure can be read comparatively as Axis Mundi, Yggdrasil/world tree, Tree of Life, Ladder and project Axis, while preserving the differences among those traditions and the Potatoverse synthesis.
master_law.earth_anchor: D4 is the observable world. Real countries, cities, institutions, companies, infrastructure, populations, money and material flows remain here even when a vertical interpretation is added.
master_law.junction: D5 is the Door: the controlled routing point where a relation may move toward integration/growth, return to D4, remain unresolved or descend toward recurrence/disintegration.
master_law.upward_gradient: Ascent trends toward narrower convergence, clarified relation, transformed recurrence, autonomous generativity, faithful transmission, integrated perspective, unity and source-facing orientation.
master_law.downward_gradient: Descent trends toward broader dispersion, sedimentation, unresolved obligation, blocked flow, orbit/capture, recurrence, opacity, fragmentation, disintegration and dust/ash imagery.
master_law.important_asymmetry: Down is not identical to evil and up is not automatically good. Roots, burial, memory, seed and stored potential can be generative below D4; Mountain or summit views can become domination if integration does not return as accountable service. Direction is determined by transformation and function, not location alone.

breadth_law.downward: broader / more dispersed / more branching degrees of unresolved relation
breadth_law.upward: narrower / more convergent / fewer degrees of unresolved dispersion

tree_crosswalk.deep_roots: D1-D3 contain closed depth, Swamp, ash, buried residue, memory, causes and roots of strife/potential.
tree_crosswalk.trunk_world: D4-D6 form the Earth/trunk/Door/Ladder transition region where real relations are observed and routed through thresholds or transformed recurrence.
tree_crosswalk.living_crown: D7-D11 move through branching Life, Garden/Rooms, transmission/light, integrated Crown and North-of-North orientation.
tree_crosswalk.cycle: seed -> burial/rooting -> Door/transition -> spiral growth -> tree/fruit -> future seed; failed processing can instead produce ash -> Mud -> Swamp -> deeper disintegration.

empirical.rule: Retain direction, quantity, compatible units, time and source. These flows may be projected through Axis operators but remain empirical records.

social_relational.rule: Represent as typed relations with evidence and uncertainty. Do not assign pseudo-physical units unless a real operational metric exists.

project_symbolic.rule: Keep in project_interpretation or explicitly project-canon records. Symbolic amounts and polarity may not overwrite or sum with financial/legal quantities.

magnetism_grammar.attraction: A relation draws actors/resources/attention toward a common center, obligation or repeating interaction.
magnetism_grammar.repulsion: A relation increases separation, exclusion or avoidance between endpoints.
magnetism_grammar.orbit_capture: Attraction plus recurrence without meaningful transformation; the relation keeps circling the same center or archive.
magnetism_grammar.convergence: Many relations become more coherent around a shared criterion, source, repair pathway or integrated system.
magnetism_grammar.dispersion: A relation fragments into more disconnected, opaque or mutually incompatible branches.
magnetism_grammar.release: A formerly binding obligation or capture relation is closed, repaired, settled or made non-coercive while provenance remains visible.

obligation_flow.downward_pattern: unresolved event -> residue -> repeated activation -> mixed provenance -> attributed obligation -> compounding/capture -> blocked exit -> disintegration
obligation_flow.upward_pattern: event -> provenance -> classification -> accountable attribution -> repair/settlement -> release -> restored agency -> generativity/service
obligation_flow.closure_rule: An obligation changes state through explicit closure conditions, not because the interface labels it positive or negative.
obligation_flow.debt_firewall: Financial/legal debt, social obligation and project-symbolic karmic debt are separate domains unless a validated conversion method exists.

computable_observable_vector.purpose: Provide future empirical/analytical signals for Axis-adjacent views without inventing one universal holiness, karma or moral score.
computable_observable_vector.rule: Keep these as a vector of separately sourced measurements. Never collapse them into a single heaven/hell rank without an explicit domain model, weighting rationale, uncertainty and validation.

signals.recurrence: Repeated activation frequency or repeated edge interaction when timestamps exist.
signals.exit_friction: Observed/modelled difficulty of leaving a relation or system, using state.agency.exit_cost or domain-specific evidence.
signals.provenance_resolution: Share/quality of claims or traces with identifiable sources, dates and contradiction handling.
signals.open_obligation: Count/value of unresolved obligations within one compatible obligation domain; never mix financial and project-symbolic units.
signals.closure_fraction: Share of scoped obligations/edges whose documented closure state is substantially_repaired, released or closed.
signals.autonomous_capacity: Whether downstream nodes gain independent capability rather than permanent dependency.
signals.relay_fidelity: Source-to-recipient preservation only where a domain defines a testable signal/message and comparison method.
signals.integration_loss: What information is hidden when many lower-level records are compressed into a Mountain/system aggregate.
signals.branching_or_dispersion: Graph fan-out, fragmentation or disconnected components where network topology is actually represented.

hydrological_crosswalk.sediment: Mud / unresolved residue carried by flow
hydrological_crosswalk.stagnation: Swamp / blocked or recursively circulating accumulation
hydrological_crosswalk.drain: downward outflow that may clear residue or reduce agency depending on design/context
hydrological_crosswalk.watershed: Mountain/high ground organizing direction and integration
hydrological_crosswalk.irrigation: directed flow that supports Garden/generative capacity
hydrological_crosswalk.soil: processed residue that becomes usable context, memory or capacity rather than recurring contamination

1.label: Deep Lower Plane
outflow: only through recovered exit, truth-test, boundary, accountability or repair pathway
1.risk: treating a temporary or disputed relation as permanently terminal

2.label: Swamp / Disintegration
outflow: more recurrence unless exit/provenance/repair channels open
2.risk: using Swamp as a moral label for a population instead of a relation/system-state

3.label: Roots of Ash
3.risk: assuming stored history automatically determines present causation

4.label: Earth / World Map
4.risk: allowing symbolic polarity to masquerade as empirical geography

5.label: North Door / First Heaven
5.risk: treating a symbolic threshold as automatic judgment

7.label: Tree of Life
7.risk: assuming every increase or expansion is healthy fruit

8.label: Garden / Rooms
8.flow_behavior: compose / circulate / cultivate among differentiated rooms
8.risk: forced unity that destroys differentiation or agency

9.label: Angels / Seeds of Light
9.risk: distortion, proxy capture or claiming supernatural transmission as measured fact

10.label: Heaven / Crown
10.flow_behavior: compress / evaluate / orient / descend as service

11.label: North of North
11.flow_behavior: select criteria / unify orientation / test invariants
outflow: criteria that must descend through D10 service into D4 consequences
11.risk: using meta-orientation to escape empirical testing or claim political authority

placement_rules: Keep real subcultures/platforms/communities on D4 as empirical nodes; D2 applies only to evidenced/project-interpreted feedback, capture and recurrence dynamics.
Keep real financial/legal obligations on D4/D3/D5 with amounts, units, dates and sources; karmic debt remains project-symbolic even if monetary language is used.
Use D3 for residue/provenance before assigning downward causation or obligation.
Use D5 whenever a relation changes regime: settlement, release, accession, authorization, refusal, repair threshold or other guarded transition.
Use D7-D10 only when downstream generativity, composition, transmission or integration can be shown; do not promote content upward merely because it sounds spiritual.
Every D10/D11 interpretation should retain a navigation path back to D4 evidence and consequences.
